name: Kitō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kitō village emblem in yellow: a winged ring enclosing a stylised arrowhead.
history: Flag of the former village of Kitō in Tokushima Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in March 1966.

features.role: Kitō village emblem — a winged ring enclosing a stylised arrowhead
